publicSummary.title: Legal and governance boundary
publicSummary.statusWording: Customer-supplied governance boundary recorded. HushVoting can serve as the voting subsystem for binding customer decisions when customer-supplied authority and rules support that use. HushVoting has not validated legal sufficiency. Missing or deferred customer-owned inputs may block or downgrade readiness claims.
allowedClaims: HushVoting can state that the customer governance boundary was recorded for the pilot scope.
HushVoting can provide FEAT-146 authority/rule input refs for abnormal outcome decisions.
HushVoting can state that proxy/delegation is out of scope while the pilot profile keeps it disabled.
blockedClaims: HushVoting may support the voting part of binding customer decisions, but must not claim AGM management, legal sufficiency validation, share-register validation, proxy collection, or meeting-minutes validation.
HushVoting must not claim runtime failed-to-finalize or finalized-with-anomaly evidence until FEAT-146 produces it.
residualRisks: Customer legal consequences, remedies, and meeting governance remain outside Hush-owned validation.
FEAT-146 is still required for signed runtime governed outcome evidence.
